hard_because: Plain fetch succeeded and server absence is already verified, so a report can easily call cleanup complete while git branch -a still shows stale tracking refs and a locked local head.

assertions.P1: Pruning command is branch-scoped and disables tag pruning (explicit --no-prune-tags or equivalent) given fetch.pruneTags=true.
assertions.P2: States that pruning removes local tracking refs only, not server branches, or otherwise keeps server deletion and tracking-ref pruning as separate operations.
assertions.P3: Reports server head, tracking ref, and local head as separately observed outcomes for each branch.
assertions.P4: Does not claim tracking-ref absence or full cleanup from unobserved commands; marks it unverified or names the deciding check.
assertions.P5: Reports feature/login local head as retained because of the lock failure (not as deleted) and does not let that failure undo verified server absence.
assertions.P6: Explains why entries remain in git branch -a (stale cached tracking refs until pruned; retained local head).
